=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 1 steps 3-5 (plan lines 268-280) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: MAIN_FIX_SHA (and MAIN_FIX_SUBJECT/MAIN_FIX_DEFAULT_BRANCH) are assigned only on the match path but read unconditionally, and the plan never initialises them; scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:179 runs set -euo pipefail.
  WHY: Every non-matching report, and every report with HEAL_MAIN_FIX_DEDUPE_ENABLED=false, aborts intake with an unbound variable, breaking G7; the EXIT-trap path is also affected (minimax). Severity MAJOR in all reports.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 4 step 3 (plan lines 410-415); scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15659, 15689-15707 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The caller persists integration_head/integration_checked_head before calling _validation_harness_hold_resume, so the helper's backup (line 15659) already holds the checked head and a dispatch-failure restore keeps it; the persist bullet also still lists "the counter" although the helper owns the counter write.
  WHY: After a transient dispatch failure the next tick skips the head, so re-validation is lost until the hold expires, contradicting "never a missed one"; the counter could be double-counted; no failed-dispatch test is planned.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3 "Closing" paragraph and step 3 "On close" (plan lines ~125, 375) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The close-retry path keyed on a pipeline-authored close marker cannot distinguish a failed PATCH from a person reopening the issue, so the hourly scan re-closes a human-reopened heal.
  WHY: It silently overrides a person's reopen decision. Severity disagreement: MAJOR (anthropic, gemini, minimax, glm) vs NIT (openai).
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3 step 3 API usage (a) and queue-ticket paragraph (plan lines ~369, 373) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The open ai/issue-<N> PR list is read before the queue ticket is taken and not re-read afterwards, while only comments are re-read.
  WHY: A heal PR opened during the wait (up to 4800 s) is missed and the issue is closed not_planned while its PR is open, violating Q8/D8.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3 step 3 listing (plan lines ~367, 371); scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh:162, 184-192 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The reused recovery-scan listing projects {number, title, body, author, last_edited_at, html_url} and omits createdAt/created_at, which the validation-pass resolution rule needs.
  WHY: The validation-pass resolution branch cannot be evaluated, or it forces an unbudgeted per-issue read. Severity disagreement: MAJOR (minimax, as a task gap) vs NIT (others).
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Files & Modules test list (plan line 435) vs Phase 3 step 6 (line 387) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The Files & Modules test list omits tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_queue.py and tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.py, which Phase 3 step 6 names.
  WHY: A PR scoped from that summary would miss both files.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 1 step 4 "Prior-suppression check first" / "One suppression per fix" (plan lines 99, 167, 261, 273-277) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The plan does not say what happens when a trusted main-fix:v1 marker's fix is still among the compare's commits, so repeat reports re-post the already-fixed comment and marker.
  WHY: This contradicts "one suppression per fix" and causes comment noise until promotion.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3 step 5 (plan line 385); scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15717-15721 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A source-resolved close routes through _validation_harness_hold_resume without a comment variant, so the helper's fixed harness-fix comment is used.
  WHY: The tracking issue is told a false cause (the pin moved and a harness fix shipped).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: G5 / Phase 3 step 2: a validation_failure heal source is resolved by a successful validation run newer than the heal's created_at (plus ai:validated)
  expected_change_site: Phase 3 step 3 listing bullet (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh:162, 184-192 projection) and Phase 3 step 6 test list / "Done when"
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The reused listing omits createdAt/created_at and the plan never adds it; the step 6 tests have no positive validation-pass close case, and "Done when" names only a closed-source-issue fixture
- requirement: Files & Modules lists the test files each phase extends
  expected_change_site: the tests bullet in Files & Modules
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: The bullet omits tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_queue.py and tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.py, which Phase 3 step 6 names
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  PROBLEM: MAIN_FIX_SHA is assigned only on the match path but read unconditionally; MAIN_FIX_SUBJECT and MAIN_FIX_DEFAULT_BRANCH are likewise never initialised, and intake runs under set -euo pipefail (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:179).

  WHY: The re-validation is lost after one transient dispatch failure, and the counter would be double-counted.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3 "Closing" paragraph and step 3 "On close" | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A pipeline close marker on an open issue is indistinguishable from a person-reopened heal.
  WHY: The next hourly scan re-closes a reopened heal.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3 step 3 API usage (a) vs queue-ticket paragraph | severity=NIT | confidence=3

  WHY: A PR opened during the wait is missed, so the issue is closed not_planned while its PR is open.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 1 step 4 "Prior-suppression check first"; Approach "One suppression per fix" | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The case where the marker's fix is still among the compare's commits is unspecified.
  WHY: The already-fixed outcome comment and marker are re-posted on each repeat report.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Phase 3 G5 and step 2 decide a validation pass by "a successful validation run … newer than the heal's `created_at`" | Expected change site: Phase 3 step 3 listing bullet (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh:184-192) | Evidence of absence: the reused listing does not fetch createdAt and the plan never adds it | severity=NIT | confidence=4
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Files & Modules lists the test files each phase extends | Expected change site: the tests bullet in Files & Modules | Evidence of absence: omits tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_queue.py and tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.py | severity=NIT | confidence=4
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  WHY: A non-matching report, including the switch-off case, aborts intake under set -euo pipefail.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3, "Closing" paragraph and "On close" step | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3

  WHY: A PR opened during the wait is missed and the issue is closed not_planned.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 4, step 3 (line 413, 415) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: integration_checked_head is persisted before dispatch, and a dispatch failure restores the snapshot that still holds it.

  PROBLEM: MAIN_FIX_SHA is assigned only on the match path and read unconditionally, never initialised; _validation_route_post is also reached from the EXIT trap (intake lines 1234, 1154, 1173).
  WHY: Unbound-variable abort under set -u on non-matching reports and the switch-off case, and on the EXIT trap path the routing marker is not posted; this contradicts G7.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 4, step 3 - plan line 413 vs 415 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Line 413 says the helper alone owns the counter write while line 415 still has the caller persist "and the counter".
  WHY: The two writes collide on validation_harness_integration_resumes, so one resume consumes two slots or is never counted.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 4, step 3 - plan lines 406, 410, 413, 415; scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15659, 15700 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The caller records the new head before the helper's backup, and a failed dispatch restores the hold with the new integration_head already in it.
  WHY: The head is never compared again, re-validation never runs, and the hold waits for a later merge or the expiry park; no test covers the path.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3, steps 2-3 - plan lines 359, 367, 371; scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh:162, 192 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
